awards.title: Mathematics National Scholarship
awards.description: Recipient of the Mathematics National Scholarship, valued at $15 000. The scholarship is awarded to approximately 10 distinguished undergraduate students in the Faculty of Mathematics, with strong academic standing and significant involvement in activities related to mathematics and computer science.

volunteering.title: Mentorship Coordinator
volunteering.description: Completed mentor-mentee pairings, and communicated with parents and students to ensure program success. Collaborated with other Auxilium team members to deliver seminars. Helped over 700 students gain tutoring experience.

volunteering.title: Math Circle Teacher
volunteering.description: Taught over 100 middle school students competition math concepts to prepare them for the CEMC Gauss Contests.
